notes.title: Punchout: Music Version 0.2.3.008 Update
notes.notes:
Hello.
Today, we've added the K.O. Mode to the game.

[h1]K.O. Mode[/h1]
In this mode, you fail the level when you miss three notes continuously.
So, you can play the game more excited!

[h1]About new levels[/h1]
New levels will added soon. Look forward to it!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
Version 0.2.3.008
[list]
[*] Added: K.O. Mode
[*] Added: Glove trails
[*] Added: Background Text Events (Not used yet)
[*] Tweaks: Music in the main menu was changed
[*] Tweaks: Rush notes are now cracked by your punch
[*] Fixed: Fixed some small bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Punchout: Music Editor Released!
notes.notes:
Hello.
We have released Punchout: Music Editor.
Punchout: Music Editor is an innovative tool which can create level for Punchout: Music.
It is included in the main game's folder.
You can open it by following the steps below:

1. Right click the "Punchout: Music" in the steam library.
2. Click Manage > Browse local files .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38605274/fa875b7f2f0719c9a9dca48b9f25cdc67851dc37.png[/img]

3. Unzip PunchoutMusicEditor.zip.
4. Double click PunchoutMusicEditor.exe to use the editor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38605274/5d12de7112eeb7f749c82db115d505c2724eb69f.png[/img]

This update doesn't change anything about the main game.

notes.title: About the issue on some VR devices
notes.notes:
Hello.
We have received reports that [b]the controller is not tracked on some VR devices (HTC VIVE COSMOS etc.).[/b]
We are currently working on this issue.
We apologize for the inconvenience.
Please wait for a while until this issue is resolved.

Punchout: Music Development Team

notes.title: Punchout: Music Version 0.2.1.007 Update
notes.notes:
Hello.

In this update, we've added three new levels composed by flat!

[h2]New levels[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38605274/bf0865f227f7845560b3626d47f9617fb92faa4f.png[/img]

notes.title: Punchout: Music Version 0.1.3.006 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!
Today we've updated Punchout: Music.
In this update, we supported Oculus Rift and added Japanese translation.
We'll add new levels and difficulties in another updates.
Thanks.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
Version 0.1.3.006
[list]
[*] Added: Oculus Rift support
[*] Added: language option
[*] Added: Japanese translation
[*] Tweaks: Song loader now using UnityWebRequest instead of WWW
[*] Tweaks: Main menu now displays game version
[*] Fixed: Some small bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Punchout: Music released as Early access!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38605274/3ba5fe190b7ff72b7e126033f5091dac0473fde2.png[/img]
